newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ Bank shares jump to record high.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ Bank shares jump to record high.

text.p: Shares in Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd jumped 11 cents to a record high of A$7.66 on Wednesday after it announced 1995/96 results.
ANZ said net profit rose 6.7 percent to A$1.12 billion for the 12 months to September 30.
Prior to the announcement, ANZ shares were trading at A$7.55, up four cents from Tuesday's close.
ANZ also announced a higher final dividend of 24 cents per share from 18 cents a year ago.
It said it expected to sustain full franking in the current 1996/97 year, but that there may be a limit on franking in following years as a higher proportion of its profits were generated offshore.
The company cited strong performance in its offshore divisions and a fall in its provision for doubtful debts as being largely responsible for the increased net profit.
"A positive result," said David Iron of James Capel.
"A dividend at 24 cents was greater than anticipated and (being) fully franked probably caught a few people out as well," said dealer David Iron of James Capel.
By 2.55 p.m. (0355 GMT), ANZ shares were 19 cents higher at A$7.70 on turnover of 4.4 milion shares.
